AMR Sensors and Perception Chapter 07. Radar Systems 07.1 Radar Sensing Principles 레이더 센싱(Radar Sensing)은 광학 센서(Optical Sensor)의 성능이 크게 저하될 수 있는 환경에서도 안정적인 환경 인식(Environmental Awareness)을 제공하기 때문에 자율 시스템(Autonomous System)에서 가장 중요한 인지 기술 가운데 하나이다. 가시광선(Visible Light)에 의존하는 카메라(Camera)나 물체가 방출하는 적외선(Infrared Radiation)을 감지하는 열화상 카메라(Thermal Camera)와 달리, 레이더는 전자기파(Electromagnetic Wave)를 능동적으로 송신하고 반사된 신호를 분석하여 주변 물체의 존재, 거리, 속도, 방향을 측정한다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Claude Code Leaked 2,539 Secrets Onto GitHub. I Checked My Own Repos the Same Morning
articles.excerpt: I found out about it the way you find out about most things that ruin your morning: a link in a group chat, no context — "bro check your repos." Apiiro had scanned public GitHub for copies of .claude/…
articles.body: I found out about it the way you find out about most things that ruin your morning: a link in a group chat, no context — "bro check your repos." Apiiro had scanned public GitHub for copies of .claude/settings.local.json — the file where Claude Code keeps your local settings — and found 104,185 copies sitting in 103,617 public repos. Of those, 1,122 copies, about 1.1%, held at least one secret. Total damage: 2,539 secrets, spread across 1,994 repos. The breakdown reads like a password manager someone dropped in a car park: 379 database passwords, 43 SSH logins, 42 GitHub, GitLab and npm tokens, 23 AWS keys. Sixty-three organisations caught in it.
articles.author: AheadKit

AMR Sensors and Perception Chapter 06. Thermal Cameras 06.1 Thermal Imaging Principles 열화상(Thermal Imaging)은 물체에서 방출되거나 반사되는 적외선(Infrared Radiation)을 감지하여 이를 온도 기반의 가시 영상으로 변환하는 수동형(Passive) 센서 기술이다. 절대영도(Absolute Zero)보다 높은 모든 물체는 전자기 에너지를 방출하며, 이 복사 에너지의 세기와 파장 분포는 물체의 온도에 따라 달라진다. 열화상 카메라(Thermal Camera)는 가시광(Visible Light)이 없어도 이러한 적외선을 감지할 수 있기 때문에 완전한 암흑 환경뿐만 아니라 연기(Smoke), 안개(Haze), 저조도(Low-Light) 환경에서도 일반 카메라보다 더 유용한 정보를 제공할 수 있다. 열화상의 물리적 원리는 열복사(Thermal Radiation)에 관한 여러 법칙으로 설명된다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

Depth Cameras 05.1 Depth Camera Principles 깊이 카메라(Depth Camera)는 주변 환경에 대한 3차원 기하학 정보(Three-Dimensional Geometric Information)를 직접 제공할 수 있기 때문에 현대 자율이동로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot, AMR)에서 가장 중요한 인지 센서(Perception Sensor) 가운데 하나로 자리 잡았다. 일반적인 RGB 카메라(RGB Camera)가 2차원의 색상 영상(Color Image)만을 획득하는 것과 달리, 깊이 카메라는 카메라와 장면(Scene)에 존재하는 모든 가시 점(Visible Point) 사이의 거리를 직접 측정한다.

articles.title: What should a scheduled job do when the laptop was asleep?
articles.excerpt: A cron expression says when a job runs and nothing else. On a server that is enough, because the machine is always on and a run rarely outlasts the gap to the next one. On a laptop neither is true. Th…
articles.body: A cron expression says when a job runs and nothing else. On a server that is enough, because the machine is always on and a run rarely outlasts the gap to the next one. On a laptop neither is true. The lid is closed at 09:00, the app that owns the schedule isn't running, and an AI agent run can take several minutes. Two questions then need answers that 0 9 * * 1-5 can't give: what happens to a firing the machine slept through, and what happens when a firing comes due while the previous run is still going. The osFoundry desktop app answers both for its scheduled agent loops, and its Rust source ( local_agent_tasks.rs ) names Temporal's Schedules as the model: an overlap policy (skip or queue) and a catch-up window (an hour, 12 hours, or however late).
articles.author: Hanako H.

articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 03 · Chapter 04 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_03_AMR_Sensors_and_Perception/blob/main/04_RGB_Cameras/04_RGB_Cameras_KR.md Volume 03. AMR Sensors and Perception Chapter 04. RGB Cameras 04.1 RGB Camera Basics RGB(Red, Green, Blue) 카메라는 자율이동로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot, AMR)에서 가장 널리 사용되는 인지(Perception) 센서 가운데 하나이다. RGB 카메라는 사람의 시각과 매우 유사한 풍부한 시각 정보를 제공하기 때문이다. 라이다(LiDAR)나 레이더(Radar)와 같은 거리 측정 센서와 달리 RGB 카메라는 주변 환경의 색상(Color), 질감(Texture), 밝기(Brightness), 윤곽선(Edge), 시각적 패턴(Visual Pattern)을 영상으로 획득한다. 이러한 정보는 로봇이 물체를 인식하고, 장면(Scene)을 이해하며, 사람을 검출하고, 교통 표지판을 해석하며, 바닥 마킹(Floor Marking)을 식별하고, 인공지능(AI) 기반 의사결정을 수행하는 데 활용된다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 03 · Chapter 03 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_03_AMR_Sensors_and_Perception/blob/main/03_3D_LiDAR/03_3D_LiDAR_KR.md Volume 03. AMR Sensors and Per…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 03 · Chapter 03 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_03_AMR_Sensors_and_Perception/blob/main/03_3D_LiDAR/03_3D_LiDAR_KR.md Volume 03. AMR Sensors and Perception Chapter 03. 3D LiDAR 03.1 3D LiDAR Principles 3D 라이다(Light Detection and Ranging, LiDAR)는 현대 자율이동로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot, AMR)에서 가장 중요한 인지(Perception) 센서 가운데 하나이며, 특히 실외, 반정형(Semi-Structured) 환경, 그리고 복잡한 산업 환경에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행한다. 단일 스캔 평면에서 거리만 측정하는 2D 라이다와 달리, 3D 라이다는 초당 수천에서 수백만 개의 레이저 펄스(Laser Pulse)를 방출하고 반사되어 돌아오는 시간을 측정하여 3차원 공간 정보를 획득한다. 이렇게 생성된 측정값은 포인트 클라우드(Point Cloud)라 불리는 고밀도의 공간 표현을 형성하며, 이를 통해 로봇은 장애물, 지형(Terrain), 자유 공간(Free Space), 주변 구조물을 더욱 정밀하게 인식할 수 있다. AMR이 점점 더 복잡하고 동적인 환경에서 운용됨에 따라, 3D 라이다는 연구용 센서에서 산업용 로봇 인지 시스템의 핵심 구성 요소로 발전하였다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: T-Mobile’s T-Mix perk changes come with a 90-day lock-in and a $15 catch
articles.excerpt: Your T-Mix perks aren't as flexible as they sound.
articles.body: TL;DR T-Mobile T-Mix customers can change their subscription Picks during the final 10 days of each 90-day cycle. Missing the window means existing subscription perks automatically carry over into the next cycle. A $15 charge per eligible partner perk allows customers to release it early for a phone promotion, while T-Mobile’s own perks remain changeable anytime. T-Mobile’s new T-Mix plans promise something wireless customers have wanted for years: more control over what they’re paying for. But that freedom comes with a few ground rules, including a limited window to change perks and a potential $15 charge if you need to switch early.

articles.excerpt: Rediscover the groundbreaking sci-fi saga that changed action cinema forever, now streaming free on Pluto TV.
articles.body: Some science fiction franchises are so ambitious they become their own cinematic languages. Star Wars built an entire galaxy with a mythology that’s still growing almost 50 years later, while Blade Runner helped define the vision of a far-future Los Angeles through rampant tech advancement and unchecked capitalism. They’re the kinds of franchises that can change the way we imagine the future, influencing everything from fashion and technology to the stories other filmmakers want to tell. Plenty of franchises have tried to capture that same vibe, but few have managed to pull it off quite like The Matrix .
articles.author: Ryan Epps

articles.excerpt: Denis Villeneuve Praises Human Creativity Over AI Prompts, Almost Announces New Bond
articles.body: Denis Villeneuve has praised human creativity over AI prompts, and playfully stirred the pot over the increasing rumours and speculation surrounding the casting of the main character in his upcoming James Bond film. Addressing the crowd at Saturday night's Art+Film fundraiser at the LACMA museum in Los Angeles where he was being honored for his contributions to cinema (thanks, THR ), the Dune: Part Three director took the opportunity to praise his heroes including Steven Spielberg and James Cameron, before speaking to the existential crisis currently being suffered by artists as a result of the rise of artificial intelligence. "At the heart of every one of my films, there’s a question I need to answer," said Villeneuve.

articles.body: Mike Flanagan knows how to make horror. He also knows how to make serialized TV . But one key thing is missing: fear.

articles.title: Legendary sci-fi magazine 'Starlog' returns as a yearly release, just in time for its 50th anniversary
articles.excerpt: Before the rise of online entertainment sites, this is where genre fans got their news
articles.body: "Starlog" was one of the greatest sci-fi and fantasy magazines ever, and after a 17-year absence, it's being resurrected. The legendary sci-fi mag went dark back in 2009 as part of the wave of popular publications folding due to years of declining readership and subscriptions. But as of Nov. 13, this geek favorite periodical returns as an annual print edition, and it's available for pre-order now. It’s another indication of digital fatigue in the world, and fans of a certain age will recall the pleasure of poring over each colorful issue packed with in-depth interviews, behind-the-scenes photos, TV guides, classic movie retrospectives, book reviews, con news, and VFX features. The triumphant relaunch of "Starlog" magazine happens on Nov.

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.

articles.body: Godzilla goes toe-to-toe with long-time foe King Ghidorah in Godzilla Minus Zero, which opened in theaters on Friday (Nov. 6). Though the three-headed golden Kaiju might seem like a natural native of Monster Island, King Ghidorah actually emerged from the depths of space. However, it isn't just the origins of King Ghidorah — also known as Monster Zero in the Godzilla movie Invasion of Astro-Monster (1965) — that are this beast's only cosmic connection. One of the largest structures in the universe, the King Ghidorah Supercluster , was named in honor of Godzilla's primary antagonist. Eat that, King Kong!
